messages:
alex_cs: Heads up — Solarflare (mid-market retail) reached out asking to onboard a hierarchical reranker for search & recommendations. They want: low-latency (p99 <120ms), support for en|es|fr, and strict PI scrubbing before any logs leave their VPC. They mentioned potential Dedicated purchase if we can meet latency. Can we run an initial feasibility + safety eval?

sam_eng: Thanks Alex. Do we have sample queries + corpus from them? need to check sequence length distribution and shard size. Also curious if they require exact top-k stability (deterministic results) or can accept nondeterministic reranking.

alex_cs: They uploaded a 2GB anonymized snippet to our intake bucket: s3://redwood-intake/solarflare/sample_v1.tar.gz (shared via signed URL). They said anonymization removed emails but kept hashed user ids. They asked explicitly that we don't retain raw traces.

sam_eng: Got it. I'll spin up an eval run on a small dedicated runner. Quick plan: 1) run accuracy vs their current model (pairwise NDCG on heldout) 2) latency profiling with 16/32 batch shapes 3) privacy check to confirm no PII leakage.

sam_eng: Pasting the eval command I'll use:
```
./tools/run_reranker_eval --model solarflare-hr-13b-q4f --data s3://redwood-intake/solarflare/sample_v1.tar.gz --metrics ndcg,map --batch-sizes 1,4,8 --latency --save-logs /tmp/solarflare_eval.log
```

maria_success: @sam_eng please include a short summary template for the customer — they want an executive-friendly report for their internal stakeholders. Also flagging renewal: Solarflare is up for renewal in 8 weeks and their account health score dropped after last month's latency incidents. This onboarding could be a good upsell, but if we miss latency SLO they may churn.

ryan_platform: @sam_eng FYI Dedicated pool availability in us-west-2 is tight next month. If we need <120ms p99 we should test both q4f quantized variants and our low-latency kernel path. Also confirm whether they'd accept prefix caching — that can cut p99 by ~30ms for repeated queries.

sam_eng: Good call. I'll test three variants: full fp16, q4f (int4), and a cached KV path. Will report p50/p95/p99 and token cost. Also will run an LLM-internal exposure sweep to detect potential extraction of any hashed IDs.

alex_cs: I've scheduled a customer sync next Tue 10am PT. @maria_success can you own the uplines with legal about the data retention clause? They want 30-day ephemeral logs and no retention outside their VPC.

maria_success: On it. I'll loop in legal and security. Also setting up a Customer Success enablement packet: checklist, what to expect from evals, rollout options (hosted -> dedicated -> private).

opsbot: ticket created: CS-4521 "Solarflare hierarchical reranker intake" assigned to sam_eng. Reminder: attach eval artifacts and privacy checklist before closing.

sam_eng: I'll upload artifacts to the ticket and attach the latency table + short exec summary by EOD Wednesday. If p99 is >120ms, we'll propose a Dedicated + KV cache pilot and include cost delta.

alex_cs: Thanks team. Keeping this high priority — potential revenue motion + retention risk. I'll follow up after the sync with the customer notes.
